_id.description: Unique identifier of the document. Pattern: <sparePartId>-UOE<nnn>

recordNo.description: Business identifier of the document, readable by people and unique within the site

siteId.description: Reference to u_mes_mdm_site._id: the site the document belongs to

siteName.description: Display value of the site, copied from u_mes_mdm_site.name

sparePartId.description: Reference to u_mes_mnt_sparePart._id: the parent document this one belongs to

sparePartName.description: Display value of sparePartId, copied from u_mes_mnt_sparePart.description

sequenceNo.description: Position of this document in its list (within the same parent for child collections), starting at 1

usedOnEquipmentId.description: Reference to u_mes_mdm_equipment._id: used on equipment

usedOnEquipmentName.description: Display value of usedOnEquipmentId, copied from u_mes_mdm_equipment.name

schemaVersion.description: Version of this collection's document structure, starting at 1
